title: The Great Wave - Part 1
summary: The first part of a long series documenting Dave Bull's Tokyo woodblock workshop as it produces a reproduction of Hokusai's The Great Wave. It follows the carving, proofing and printing of the reward print for Kickstarter backers.
why: HN commenters hold it up as a top-tier long-form process video, recommended whenever the Great Wave or Hokusai comes up.

quote.text: The series is up there with Clickspring's skeleton clock in my pantheon of "greatest long-form process videos
